A single blue line connects data points from 1880 to 1891.
The line starts at approximately 1,100 in 1880 and ends at approximately 3,000 in 1891.
The line is generally upward sloping, indicating an increase in the number of new tourists over time.
The line has a steeper slope from 1888 to 1891 compared to earlier years.
There are no other visual elements, such as legends, gridlines, or annotations, besides the title, axes, and the blue line.
